text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
One might say that. I fear I got a little<n>absorbed in
my reading.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Punnery is a truly bottomless art. Didyou know that overly elaboraterhymes can make a joke lessamusing?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Brevity is the soul of wit, indeed.<n>Timing is as
crucial in comedy as it is<n>in racing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how I racked my brain,<n>I couldn't
think of a good punchline.<n>Before I knew it, it was
past<n>midnight...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You could say it wasn't very much...<n>pun.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's grogginess seems<n>to have had a
serious effect on the<n>quality of her jokes.
